tagline: Explore, add your own data and save your map
disclaimer: Basemaps and map layers may not reflect the current map policy of this programme.

strings.dropHint: Drop a CSV file with latitude and longitude columns onto the map, or a saved map (.mmap).
strings.noResults: No layers match. Try another word or topic.
strings.sketchHint: Draw points, lines and areas. They are saved with your map.
strings.animHint: 3D animations of physical processes. They open in the 3D view.
strings.discard: You have unsaved changes. Discard them?
strings.notMapFile: That isn't a saved map (.mmap) from here.
strings.layerFailed: Couldn't add {title}. It may not be public.
strings.csvSkipped: {n} rows had no usable latitude and longitude and were left out.
strings.csvA1: Your data needs to start in the top-left cell (A1). Remove any blank rows above your headings.
strings.csvA1col: Your data needs to start in the top-left cell (A1). The first column has no heading.
strings.csvNoHeading: Column {n} has no heading. Every column needs a name in row 1.
strings.csvNoRows: There's no data under the headings. Add at least one row.
strings.csvTooMany: That's {n} rows. This app can map up to {max}. Try a smaller file.
strings.csvNoLatLon: Couldn't find latitude and longitude columns. Name them Latitude and Longitude (Lat and Lon also work).
strings.csvNoCoords: None of the rows had usable latitude and longitude. Use decimal degrees, for example 51.5 and -0.12.
